headline: Bitcoin Stabilizes Near $76,900 Amid Spot ETF Outflows
summary: Bitcoin edged up 0.2% to approximately $76,900 following a dip to $76,300. Spot exchange-traded funds recorded outflows of $399 million for a second consecutive day, while Binance customers withdrew a net $4.72 billion.
why: Bitcoin is the leading cryptocurrency by market capitalization, and spot ETFs provide institutional market access. Monitoring exchange flows and ETF demand helps investors gauge market liquidity and sentiment.
